name: Tommee Tippee Natural Start 2x Fast Flow Soft Teat 2s Pack 6m+
description:
Product details of Tommee Tippee Natural Start Fast Flow Soft Teat – 2pcs Pack (6m+)

Product Type: Baby Bottle Teat / Nipple

Quantity: 2 pieces per pack

Age Suitability: 6 months+

Material: Soft, skin-like silicone

Flow Type: Fast Flow

Key Features:

Skin-like feel: Soft silicone teat gently elongates for a natural and comfortable feeding experience.

Anti-colic design: Built-in sensitive anti-colic valve reduces excessive air intake, helping to prevent colic, gas, and discomfort.

Easy latch-on: Award-winning teat design loved by mums and babies for smooth, fuss-free feeding.

Natural flex & movement: Mimics the natural flex and feel of breastfeeding for easier bottle acceptance.
